headline: Olavi's Wake and Weathered Expanse Erupt with Rapid Base Turnovers
war_summary: Base exchanges surged sharply across Olavi's Wake and Weathered Expanse over the past three hours, headlining a volatile midday front. Olavi's Wake shifted rapidly from steady attrition into direct structural combat, recording four base turnovers in the past two hours, while Weathered Expanse continued its furious clash with six fresh transitions and over thirteen hundred casualties in the same span. Marban Hollow likewise re-entered the shift ledger with two base changes after earlier stagnation, matching steady two-hour turnover tallies in Linn of Mercy and Pari Peak. In contrast, base exchanges in Kuura Strand and Nevish Line tapered off after heavy morning action, recording no structural flips in the latest two-hour window. Meanwhile, intense attritional grinding persists without territorial change across Callahan's Passage, Dead Lands, and Farranac Coast, where combined casualty tolls spiked into the hundreds per hour.
